cidrs.description: List of CIDRs that this group applies to.
cidrs.rationale: CIDRs define reachable networks over IAP TCP; overly broad ranges expand blast radius.

deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.

fqdns.description: List of FQDNs that this group applies to.
fqdns.rationale: Defines the destination hostnames reachable through the IAP TCP tunnel group. A policy should block wildcard/overly-broad FQDN patterns so the tunnel cannot reach an unbounded set of hosts; it should not pin specific hostnames, which are team-specific.

group_name.rationale: Name/identifier of the tunnel destination group. Resource names are not security controls and a generic policy cannot constrain free-text names usefully.

project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: Non-secret project identifier scoping the destination group. We don't constrain project references, and a generic policy cannot know the correct project.

region.description: The region of the tunnel group. Must be the same as the network resources in the group.
region.rationale: Determines the region/zone where the resource is created. Policy should restrict it to an approved-region whitelist for data residency; the allowed set is parameterised (a hardcoded example whitelist is acceptable).
